authentication_type.description: Default authentication algorithm for IPMI LAN sessions. Valid values: none, md2, md5, straight_password, OEM.

privilege_level.description: Default privilege level for IPMI sessions. Valid values: callback, user, operator, admin.

cipher_suite_id.description: RMCP+ cipher suite ID for IPMI 2.0 RAKPv23. -1 = auto-select; valid 0–15 per IPMI spec.

workarounds.description: List of workarounds to enable for vendor-specific quirks. Valid values: skipchecks, force_ipmi15, etc. (See freeipmi.conf(5)).

in_band_driver_path.description: Path to the in-band BMC device driver (e.g., /dev/ipmi0, /dev/bmc, /dev/dcmi).

in_band_slave_address.description: IPMI slave address (hex) for in-band communication.
